run_generate_id_cond: run the script to generate identity conditioning outputs for all identities using a trained autoencoder checkpoint
run_train_csv_loader: run the train_csv_loader to load capture data from a CSV file with specified dataset directory and number of identities
run_get_autoencoder: run get_autoencoder to construct an autoencoder model from a dataset and asset path
run_load_checkpoint: run load_checkpoint to load trained model weights from a checkpoint file into the autoencoder
run_id_encoder: run the autoencoder id_encoder to generate identity conditioning outputs from normalized neutral vertices and textures
